title: Excavator threatens sacred alpine lake in the Himalayas
html:
Excavator threatens sacred alpine lake in the Himalayas

Footage of an excavator near Sheshnag Lake in India-administered Kashmir has sparked outrage. Activists are warning the government’s push to build new roads and tunnels could damage the area’s fragile Himalayan ecosystem, and potentially lead to an ecological disaster.
summary: Footage of an excavator near Sheshnag Lake in India-administered Kashmir has sparked outrage.
